name: RNA binding motif protein 10
pathways: negative regulation of ribosomal large subunit export from nucleus

function.text: RBM10 encodes ribosome biogenesis inhibitor MINAS-60. It participates in negative regulation of ribosomal large subunit export from nucleus.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to TARP syndrome (x-linked).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Lung Adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma; Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: X-linked; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
